name: backupCoveragePercentage
definition: The percentage of backup-capable resources that have a restorable point no older than 7 days from any backup mechanism.
population: every backup-capable resource found in the scanned regions (denominator); those with a restorable point from the last 7 days (numerator)
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A per-resource list of the account's backup-capable resources with each one's newest restorable time.
